policy: No source is approved for ingestion until its exact upstream terms, access conditions, provenance, and file hashes are reviewed and recorded in the private source_approvals.json manifest.

blockers: Confirm exact upstream source provenance and terms for every component
Review dataset card and license version at pinned revision
Do not use for commercial training or public redistribution
Obtain private access and retain attribution metadata
Dataset is machine-translated from FineWeb-Edu; verify upstream rights and transformation terms
Review access conditions and pinned dataset revision
Do not use for commercial training or public redistribution
Derived from other datasets; verify upstream rights and transformation terms
Arabizi is Latin-script Egyptian and must not be treated as Arabic-script dialogue
Review access conditions and pinned dataset revision
NonCommercial and NoDerivatives terms; do not ingest into model training unless rights holder explicitly confirms training permission in writing
Keep benchmark evaluation separate from training
Gated access requires accepting contact-information terms
Research-only use and non-redistribution conditions must be followed
Review ShareAlike implications for any derived model or weights before training
Dataset card says examples originate from TV-series subtitles; uploader license alone does not establish rights to underlying scripts/subtitles
Do not ingest until rights holder permission or provenance is independently verified

ingestion_invariants: Never store downloaded corpus files or access tokens in Git.
Pin each dataset to an immutable revision and record the revision and source URL.
Record source license, upstream provenance, access terms, attribution, file SHA-256, and exact character/record counts.
Keep research-only data and derived checkpoints private; never promote them to a commercial/public model without separate rights clearance.
Deduplicate by normalized conversation/message hashes before splitting.
Split by conversation/source group into train, validation, and test before tokenizer fitting; test must never affect training or checkpoint selection.
Do not auto-approve a source from a dataset-card license string; require human rights review and private exact-file approval.
